groups.title: 1 - BRAIN: checkpoint loader
groups.description: Loads sd_xl_base_1.0. Its 3 output cables feed everything: MODEL>sampler, CLIP>both prompt boxes, VAE>decoder. 25 steps, cfg 7.0 — quality rung for identity work (~40s warm). Identity lives in node 2's words, never in these settings.

groups.title: 2 - WORDS IN: positive prompt (EDIT THIS)
groups.description: What TO draw. The only box you routinely edit: identity/subject/scene words live here. CLIP cable from node 1 must stay connected or these are just decoration.

groups.title: 3 - WORDS OUT: negative prompt (bans)
groups.description: What is BANNED from the image. Add newly-seen failures here; never remove entries. Same CLIP cable as node 2.

groups.title: 4 - BLANK CANVAS: output size
groups.description: Width x height in px, then batch (keep 1). Tall 768x1344 = full body; wide 1344x768 = scenes. Size shapes composition, not quality.

groups.title: 5 - PAINTER: sampler (seed lives here)
groups.description: Seed 1001 = the dice roll: same seed + same words = same image. control_after_generate=fixed keeps your seed between Queues. Steps/cfg/sampler frozen — touch seed first, words second, these last. 25 steps, cfg 7.0 — quality rung for identity work (~40s warm). Identity lives in node 2's words, never in these settings.

groups.title: 6+7 - DEVELOP + SAVE: pixels to disk
groups.description: Node 6 develops the sketch into pixels (no settings; if it looks burnt the cause is upstream cfg/prompt). Node 7 writes the PNG — filename prefix widget names your files. Only writer on the canvas.
